ev_0005.summary: Confirmed. Four labeled points A, B, C, D lie on one circle centered at unlabeled point O (224.29, 201.88), radius 157.28 px. Each point's distance from O is within about 0.2 px of the radius (A and B are about 157.1 and 157.2, C about 157.5, D about 157.3). O is the midpoint of AB, so AB is a diameter (A and B are endpoints). AB is horizontal at y~201 and DC is horizontal at y~65, so AB is parallel to DC. Their midpoints both sit at x~224.3, which matches O's x, so ABCD is symmetric about the vertical axis through O. Legs AD and BC are both about 157 px long and are equal, so ABCD is an isosceles trapezoid inscribed in the circle. Segment endpoints overshoot their vertices by 4-9 px, which is detector noise, so they are snapped to the vertices. No right-angle marks were verified, so none are claimed.
